title: research: independently verify complex owner/common-view directions
body:
The retained original PR3385 owner checks use the identity cover for the first forward/backward local groups, where reversing cover/chart multiplication is invisible. This package independently reconstructs every original owner and checks the unchanged selector and affine wrapper construction at a noncommuting cover. The source's separate nonidentity terminal-translation test is credited explicitly.

The audit covers 101,376 owner occurrences across 144 calls, including 10,002 emitted helper charts. A conditional all-cover proof derives `d sigma^-1`, the entry/exit conjugations and packet partition. The finite check uses a declared exact-matrix cover adapter for all local groups, with two separate actual ordinal round trips. Six semantic source mutations and a counterfeit-source control challenge the checks. The real call0 helper witness distinguishes correct and reversed composition by `e0 -> 602` versus `e0 -> 518`.

Validation: both registered CPython 3.12.15 commands, including isolated optimized warnings-as-errors; metadata and committed-byte/source-history checks; all eight frozen files compared with their original Git bytes. No full physical O73/GL64 payload, complete cover-encoder proof, local/native arithmetic proof, uniform invoice, changed T74 caller or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Package: `research/complex-owner-view-refinement`. Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2238#discussioncomment-19010098

Credit Jose Manuel's PR3385 and its retained predecessor ledger, PR3106's first-prefix/partition result, and PR2569's binary owner/common routing. This is source-relative direction coverage, not a new routing identity. Prepared by Sagar Thakrar with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate same-session review; not independent human acceptance or a formal kernel certificate.
